qualified_claims: Within the preregistered full-realization envelope, a read-only SWAP management request can be allocated and physically realized by real Ribasim and returned as distinct allocation and supply quantities to the same SWAP management origin.

Discarding an independent real Ribasim candidate leaves the accepted Ribasim origin unchanged in the fixture, and same-origin candidate replay reproduces allocation, physical supply and Basin endpoint.

The real Ribasim allocation and physical supply can be consumed by the qualified RM06 transaction with reject/replay identity and exactly one accepted management-state commit.
Gross physical supply remains distinct from net SWAP surface application after Rutter interception.

relationship_to_rm08.meaning: RM09 does not overwrite the RM08 falsification; it establishes the narrower profile in which full realization is valid.
